partners.signatory_authority: The Director of the Maritsa Vegetable Crops Research Institute signs for the institute, with the Agricultural Academy countersigning where its statutes reserve the signature to the Academy. The post is held by Prof. Dr. Daniela Ganeva.
partners.signatory_authority_note: PLACEHOLDER, written on the operator's authorisation of 2026-08-14 and declared in working_assumptions.json under key signatory_authority_MVCRI. What is open is a question of Bulgarian law and of the Agricultural Academy's statutes — institutes of the Academy are structural units, so the signature may sit with the institute or with the Academy — and nothing consulted settles it. The placeholder takes the institute-signs reading and names the Academy as countersignatory, which is the form that is wrong in the smallest way if the Academy turns out to hold the signature alone. One half is not a placeholder and should be kept when the rest is corrected: the Director's post is held by Prof. Dr. Daniela Ganeva, named as director of the structural unit in the Agricultural Academy's own press record. That is a 2024-era source and must be re-checked before any document is signed. This binds at partnership-agreement time; it blocks no gate and no proposal section, so the placeholder buys a phase pass and nothing that reaches an evaluator.

partners.company_registration_number_note: Resolved on 2026-08-14 against the Hungarian company register — a resolution, not the placeholder the operator authorised. The contradiction was between an implied 01-09-884056 and the 13- prefix the tax number's county code predicts. The register carries an entity whose every discriminating field matches this record exactly: legal name AGROVIR Üzletviteli Tanácsadó Korlátolt Felelősségű Társaság, seat 2040 Budaörs, Kinizsi utca 30, tax number 14000838-2-13, main activity TEÁOR 70.20. Its cégjegyzékszám is 13-09-200433. The 01-09- reading is a Budapest-court record and matches none of the four discriminating fields; nothing here asserts what that record is, only that it is not the entity this one describes. The prediction in the earlier note was therefore correct and is what carried the identification. Recorded Confirmed on the register match rather than Assumed on the operator's authorisation, so no declaration backs it and the placeholder offered for this field is not used. One residue for Part A: the register gives the county-court registration, and if the company was registered elsewhere before moving to Budaörs, the earlier number may still appear on old documents. Part A takes the current one.
